content.description:
✨ ONE PLATFORM, A WHOLE WORLD OF OPPORTUNITY

The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.

We're proof that a high-performing culture doesn't need an office. Distributed across 60+ countries since 2020, we've built something the industry keeps noticing:

- Ranked #10 of 250 on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of America's Top WorkTech Companies https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-hr-named-10-of-americas-top-worktech-companies-of-2026-by-time

- Named one of America's Greatest Startup Workplaces 2026 https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-2026-newsweek-award by Newsweek

- A G2 Spring 2026 Leader https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-named-best-roi-for-any-global-employment-platform-for-g2-spring-2026 across Employer of Record, Global Employment, Multi-country Payroll, and HR Compliance

- The only B Corp-certified global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023

Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.

And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.

THE ROLE

Location: While this position is posted in a specific location, all of Oyster’s positions are fully remote and you can work from home. Forever. To create the best experience for our new hire, this role requires you to be based within the Americas time zone.

All applications will be reviewed after the submission deadline on Dec 7th, and we’ll be in touch with next steps shortly after. We appreciate your patience and interest in joining the team.

Role Summary

Own pipeline creation and acceleration across the Americas as the field marketing partner to regional Sales. Translate global demand programs into focused regional plays, build locally relevant programs when needed, and connect every investment to target accounts and measurable commercial outcomes. This is a hands-on role combining independent planning, integrated campaign delivery, end-to-end event execution, stakeholder influence, and budget accountability.

Oyster helps companies hire, pay, and care for talent anywhere. This role offers the opportunity to build a visible regional growth engine for a global employment platform, with direct feedback from Sales and clear ownership of results.

Key Responsibilities

- Build and execute a quarterly Americas field plan tied to regional pipeline needs, priority accounts, opportunity stages, and available budget.

- Run planning cadences with Sales leaders, AEs, and SDRs/BDRs; participate in deal reviews and agree specific account support and follow-up ownership.

- Deliver integrated programs spanning regional events, executive roundtables, ABM, direct mail, digital activation, and Sales-aligned outbound; choose channels to fit the audience and buying stage.

- Adapt centrally built programs while preserving message quality; create regional plays where customer evidence warrants a different approach.

- Partner with Partner Marketing on strategic sponsorships and joint go-to-market initiatives, including shared goals, promotion, lead handling, and follow-up.

- Manage event logistics, vendors, contracts within agreed authority, budget, inventory, staffing, onsite experience, promotion, and post-event activation.

- Coordinate Demand Generation, Digital, Creative, Content, and GTM Operations dependencies with clear briefs, deadlines, and accountable owners.

- Measure sourced and influenced pipeline, cost per opportunity, conversion, velocity, and return; document experiments, scale effective plays, and stop weak investments.

- Own the regional field budget and maintain spend forecasts, trade-offs, and performance reporting.

- Use AI to accelerate planning, outreach personalization, and buying-signal research, with human validation, appropriate data handling, and reusable team workflows.

Core Requirements

- B2B SaaS marketing experience commensurate with the brief’s 5–8-year guideline, including at least 3 years of field marketing or regional demand generation supporting quota-carrying sales teams.

- Quantifiable sourced and influenced pipeline results, with a clear account of personal ownership, reporting methodology, and commercial outcomes.

- Integrated program experience across events, ABM, digital, and partner channels, rather than isolated event logistics or lead-volume activity.

- Funnel fluency across MQL, SAL, SQL, pipeline coverage, conversion, and velocity; ability to explain data limitations and defend investment choices with Sales and Finance.

- Hands-on Salesforce and HubSpot experience for campaign execution, follow-up workflows, and performance visibility.

- Independent strategic planning and precise hands-on execution, including vendors, event delivery, and budget management.

- Strong written and verbal communication and evidence of influencing Sales leaders without direct authority in a remote-first environment.

- Practical ability to apply AI to field marketing workflows while checking output quality and protecting confidential and personal data.

- Travel required: 15-20%

Bonus / Nice-to-Have Experience

- HR technology, EOR, payroll, or global employment experience.

- Marketing into LATAM or Canada.

- Spanish or Portuguese language skills relevant to target markets; not mandatory.

- Intent platforms, direct mail tools, and event platforms.

This might not be right for you if...

- You prefer event delivery without accountability for pipeline quality, opportunity progression, and return.

- You want strategy-only work rather than owning logistics, vendors, budgets, and follow-up.

- You rely on central teams for every execution decision or avoid influencing Sales when priorities conflict.

- You prefer reporting attendance and leads without testing how programs contribute to commercial outcomes.

You'll also need

- A reliable home internet connection and fluency in both written and spoken English.

HOW WE WORK TOGETHER AT OYSTER

Our values guide the work we do, the decisions we make, and the culture that makes Oyster what it is. We make it happen—progress is our default setting. We drive change, we build and give trust, and we move as one united team.

Our mission is to create a more equal world of work: helping companies everywhere hire, pay, and care for talent anywhere. Everything we do ladders up to our mission. We embrace asynchronous, collaborative work and share how we operate in the Oyster Public HQ https://oysterhr.notion.site/Welcome-to-The-Reef-Oyster-s-Open-Source-Employee-Guide-fc482e3f107c4afd8c85ed217f1d0c1d so other global teams can learn from us.

HOW YOU WORK

With diverse locations, cultures, and needs, we created How YOU Work; https://oysterhr.notion.site/How-YOU-work-ac16c1932e314ffd8cb693e332458395 a program supporting your whole human experience at Oyster:

- Work from anywhere: Oyster has no borders or HQ. As long as work is timely, your team is supported, and you're authorized to work where you live, you can work from anywhere.

- Paid time off: Enjoy 40 days off per year (including holidays and vacation), or more if required by your country.

- Mental health support: Access Plumm https://oysterhr.notion.site/Plumm-3b5e7e70dec6428e975f68f25972cfb7, our mental well-being service.

- Wellbeing allowance: Each month, receive a wellbeing allowance in your ThanksBen wallet to spend on a wide range of options.

- Flexible parental leave: All new parents are eligible for at least three months’ paid leave, with job protection for up to 12 months or as required locally.

- WFH stipend: Receive a stipend for your laptop and home office equipment to get you set up quickly.

✨ THE BEST JOBS SHOULD BE AVAILABLE TO EVERYONE

We embrace diverse perspectives and intentionally build our product and company with an inclusive, global mindset. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every criterion, and are committed to a trust-based, thriving environment.

Oyster is committed to ensuring equal opportunity of employment for qualified persons with disabilities and actively fosters an inclusive work environment. If you require reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process, please email jobs@oysterhr.com with the subject line: Interview Accommodations.

Our available positions are on our careers page. Our team will only contact you from an @oysterhr.com email, and we will never ask for money as part of an interview process or job offer. If you receive a suspicious email about Oyster jobs or are directed to a site other than www.oysterhr.com/careers http://www.oysterhr.com/careers, please report it via our Compliance and Ethics Helpline https://faceup.com/c/8tpzyyye.
